propositions: Cancelled CI runs on main render as red X on healthy commits because concurrency.cancel-in-progress: true supersedes pushed runs; GitHub Actions offers no native suppression.

Four of five major Gerrit-primary mirrors (Go, OpenStack, LibreOffice, AOSP) surface zero per-commit CI on their GitHub mirrors; real post-merge signals live on dedicated post-merge systems (LUCI, Zuul periodic pipelines, Chromium sheriffs).

Removing push-to-main triggers and shifting to schedule-only 6-hourly runs eliminates cancellations by construction while preserving pre-merge Gerrit Verified gating (which runs on gerrit-verify.yaml, not test.yml).

Scheduled main health runs must publish the last-known-green SHA and a git bisect run recipe to the workflow summary so first responders can bisect multi-commit regressions without reconstruction under pressure.
Branch-push CI for non-main topics and weekly/daily cadences for expensive workflows (prompt-eval, codeql, terraform-drift) must be preserved unchanged.
